EGY.note: No rule or authority on AI harms is stated.
Government services are named only as an intended application area of Karnak, not as a use in service or a pilot.
Education and legal guidance are named only as intended application areas, with no public sector system using AI.

facts.fact: Egypt's ICT minister said engineers and researchers at the ministry's Applied Innovation Center developed Karnak, the first national Arabic large language model, which according to international evaluation platforms tops Arabic models in the 30 and 40 billion parameter classes.

systems.owner: Applied Innovation Center, Ministry of Communications and Information Technology
